description: Separate frozen ninth comparator baseline (nine existing learned rows include our model). HimNet KDD 2024 Dong et al.; unmodified official commit 2a9aa44d1864f6fb60bdf9d14bafd6c1681e81a5. Core20: PEMS04 (307 closest to 240 movement nodes), Extended30: PEMS03 (358 closest to 360). hidden_dim64, cheb_k2, layers1, node/st embeddings16/16, TOD/DOW12/4 and8/8 respectively, tf_decay_steps4000, teacher forcing enabled only during training; future TOD/DOW are known target calendar labels. Shared protocol replaces official batch16, milestone schedule, max_epochs200, early_stop20, Adam eps0.001 with AdamW defaults, batch64, 50x500, plateau patience3 (reduce after four bad epochs), early stop8, wd1e-4, three-LR validation search. Same train-only per-channel scaling, vehicle MAE, clipping and metrics; learned adaptive graph as official (no supplied corridor graph). Source and configs SHA256 verified before prepare and import. No original/completed experiment modified. Adapter checkpoints each official decoder step during training (no numerical/model change; curriculum RNG outside recomputation), reducing retained meta-weight activations at batch64; adds recomputation overhead. Official source remains unmodified.
split: chronological 70/10/20 as stored in each dataset; training-only channel scaling
loss: mean absolute error on vehicle counts (inverse training scaling)
evaluation: test forecasts clipped at zero vehicles for every model; MAE, RMSE and WMAPE per horizon step

excluded_models.d2stgnn: about 0.2 s per batch and 23 GB with 240-360 movement nodes; excluded before any result for computational cost

graph: movement-level corridor graph (experiments/movement_graph.py); graph baselines receive the same graph

runtime_estimate.reason: Original AGCRN means108.65/121.68s per epoch imply3.20h for12runs at50epochs on6workers assuming unchanged per-job throughput. HimNet has two64-unit recurrent encoders plus12step meta-parameter decoder and training decoder checkpoint recomputation. 4-10h provisional allowance; early stopping, queue, memory contention and actual hardware can change it. No GPU runtime or peak memory measured.
